page.overview:
Who is Xiza?

Xiza is a playable character of War of the Visions: Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Known as the Devoted Fighter, she is a monk affiliated with the Crystal Sanctum that was sent to Hourne as a spy, infiltrating its first division, Solidus.

Xiza is a UR-rarity unit of the Dark element whose main job is Monk, while her sub jobs are Thief and Lancer. She can equip the following items: Fist, Hat, Clothing, Accessory. Her unit cost is 80.

Her Master Ability increases her own Evasion by 10 and Strike Attack by 5. Her limit burst is Tiger Gnaw, which deals Dmg (L) to target & bestows augmented Man Eater.

Her Trust Master Reward is the Illusory Bells accessory, which bestows HP +142, DEF +8, AGI +7 and the Revitalize ability, which bestows AP Auto-Restore on self for 3 turns.
